name: financetech
description: FinanceTech — gestão financeira e administrativa para pequenos empreendedores

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:setup -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.vercel-build: npm run db:migrate:deploy -w server && npm run prisma:generate -w server && npm run build -w client
